deskyard env use: set a server's default environment

Usage: deskyard [-e ENV] env use ENV|SERVER/ENV

Checks that you can see the environment ENV on the default server (or SERVER),
then makes it that server's default environment, used when -e isn't given.

Arguments:
  ENV        string      required  environment name, or SERVER/ENV

Prints: a confirmation line

Examples:
  deskyard env use alice
  deskyard env use work/bob

Where: on this machine, talking to the server
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
